name: Clickback WVI
author: Team Clickback

sections.description:
Clickback’s Website Visitor Identification (WVI) plugin is a feature of Clickback, a cold email marketing platform. WVI provides you with the names of companies that visit your website/landing page from your Clickback cold email campaigns. This provides an additional and powerful analytic that allows you to turn visits into sales leads. This plugin lets you easily add your unique Clickback WVI account token to your website/landing page via the Clickback WVI WordPress plugin.

Features

The Clickback WVI plugin is a powerful cold email campaign analytics tool to understand which of your cold contacts visited your website/landing page. You can also see which contacts converted or filled in a form on your website/landing page.

In this day and age, we always want to understand more about our leads. There is no better way than by adding the WVI plugin to your website/landing page to capture data on your cold contacts’ interactions with your website/landing page.

Instead of relying on basic open and click data that has a level of inaccuracy due to bots that the MXs use to test links in email messages received by their servers, Clickback’s WVI provides accurate analytics and real contact information, including a contact’s first and last name, email address, the pages they visited, and how long they spent on your website.

You can learn more about the Clickback WVI feature at Clickback.com.
sections.installation:
1. Log into your website’s WordPress administration section
  2. Go to Plugins, click the Add New Plugin
  3. In the search plugins box, type “Clickback”
  4. Click the “Install Now” button
  5. Once installed, click the “Activate” button
  6. Click the Settings link for the plugin
  7. Sign into your Clickback account
  8. Navigate to Admin Options > Website Visitor Intelligence (WVI) Tracking Code
  9. Choose the WordPress Plugin option
  10. Copy your Account Token
  11. Paste the Account Token in the Account Token area
  12. Click Test Token to verify the connection
  13. Click Save Settings
  14. Now you are done setting up the WVI tracking code!
